prompt: Develop a Meridian Offline Commerce & Compliance Portal system for organizations that need to run internal auctions, manage controlled documents, and publish regulated communications without relying on any internet connectivity. The application supports four primary roles: Administrator (configures rules and data), Content Editor (authors listings, announcements, and documents), Reviewer/Approver (moderates content and approves workflows), and Participant (bids, searches products, completes trainings, and reads notices). Users sign in with a local username and password, then land on a React SPA workspace with a left navigation Drawer and a tabbed main area. The Auction workspace provides scheduled start/end times, anti-sniping auto-extension (extend by 2 minutes when a valid bid is placed in the last 30 seconds), proxy bidding (user sets a maximum; the engine auto-bids to maintain lead), minimum increment rules (e.g., $1 under $50, $5 from $50–$500, $10 above $500), and optional deposit/credit thresholds (default deposit is 10% of starting price, minimum $50, tracked as a local “credit wallet”). A Bid Modal validates bid amount, auction status, and bidder eligibility, and a Results Table shows a traceable bid timeline with timestamps, bidder alias, and rule-trigger events (extensions and proxy steps). The Content & Search area lets users browse a local product catalog with category/brand/price/spec filters, sorting by sales/price/new arrivals, keyword suggestions based on recent searches, trending keywords computed over the last 7 days, reviews with 1–5 star ratings, and sensitive-word moderation that blocks publishing until a Reviewer approves. The Publishing Workbench supports announcements/news/carousels with an approval workflow, targeted publishing by organization/role/tag, version rollback (retain last 20 versions), and readership analytics (unique readers and time-on-page). The Document & Archive module provides templates, numbering (e.g., ORG-2026-000123), drafting, checkout with approval, preview with a visible watermark (“CONFIDENTIAL – INTERNAL USE”), metadata/tags, multidimensional search, and retention policies (default 7 years; destruction requires a two-step approval with audit logs). The Message Center provides in-app notifications with templates, scheduled or rule-triggered delivery, read receipts, retry (3 attempts at 1/5/15 minutes), and subscription preferences; SMS/email/official-account channels are represented as exportable outbound queues for offline handoff (CSV/JSON). Built as a React + TypeScript pure frontend single-page application with client-side routing, all business logic runs in a frontend service layer over mock data and locally imported JSON configuration. Persistent data (auctions, bids, documents, content versions, audits) is stored in IndexedDB with indexed fields for fast search and pagination; lightweight preferences and session hints use LocalStorage. To keep bidding consistent across tabs, the auction engine uses IndexedDB transactions plus a per-auction lock and a client-generated idempotency key (UUID) per bid to prevent double-apply; cross-tab updates are broadcast via the browser BroadcastChannel API. Passwords are never stored in plain text; they are salted and derived with PBKDF2, with a minimum 12-character policy and lockout after 5 failed attempts for 15 minutes. Sensitive fields (deposit wallet, restricted document metadata) are encrypted at rest using Web Crypto, and audit trails are append-only with immutable event IDs. Import/export uses browser-side file selection and Blob-based downloads (e.g., FileSaver-style), enabling full offline backup, restore, and controlled data transfer.
